title: Newly Established Beauty Salon for Sale in Dubai, UAE
tagline: We’re a premium beauty salon offering a range of top-notch personal care services like nails, hair styling, lash extensions, facials, waxing, and relaxing massages. - We've welcomed over 1,000 satisfied clients in our first year, with annual revenue reaching AED 350,000. - We pride ourselves on providing a unique salon experience that combines quality treatments with great convenience, tailored for clients who value excellence. - Our team consists of 5 skilled employees who are dedicated to delivering outstanding customer service and results. - This is a fully fitted, ready-to-run salon located in a prime mall spot, making it easily accessible for our customers. - We’re anticipating break-even within 3 to 5 months by focusing a bit on marketing efforts, making this an attractive investment opportunity. - Ownership is straightforward, with just two shareholders (Husband & wife), and we operate without any external loans, keeping things clean and simple.
